extracted.name: Slow Cooker Squirrel and Veggies
extracted.description: This squirrel recipe is made by simmering meat in a slow cooker with potatoes, onion, carrots, garlic, and bell pepper until tender and flavorful.
ingredient_lines: 4 large potatoes, cut into small chunks
1 large green bell pepper, cut into chunks
3 squirrels - skinned, gutted, and cut into pieces
instruction_lines: Place potatoes, onion, carrots, bell pepper, garlic, chicken bouillon, salt, and pepper in a slow cooker. Lay squirrel meat on top of vegetable mixture. Pour in enough water to cover completely.
Cover and cook on High for 6 hours. Stir in flour until incorporated and continue cooking for 2 more hours.
